question: The_______ is celebrated at Shilpgram in February every year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taj Mahotsav**__.

__
 
• **The Taj Mahotsav is an annual 10-day (from 18 to 27 February) event at Shilpgram in Agra, India**__.

 __
 
• The festival brings back memories of the old Mughal period and the Nawabi style prevalent in Uttar Pradesh in the 18th and 19th centuries.
